name: Riley

origin.summary: Honors Army Sergeant First Class Riley Stephens, 39, killed in Afghanistan on September 28, 2012. A running-and-lunging sandwich — 1.5 miles, 150 burpees, 1.5 miles — traditionally worn with a 20-lb vest.

description: Two 1.5-mile runs bookending 150 burpees — a running-first chipper with one large bodyweight movement in the middle.
source_notes: crossfit.com/benchmark/riley (official CrossFit Hero WOD page), retrieved 2026-07-08; official Rx adds an optional load: 'If you've got a weight vest or body armor, wear it.'
